quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Count up to 165 in your head, saying each number word as you go.
quests.explanation: The numeral 165 is written in words as "One Hundred Sixty-Five" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: When you can read big math words like 'One Hundred Sixty-Five', you are becoming a true math master!

quests.instruction: Which number is smaller: 136 or 180?
quests.hint: Compare the digits from left to right: which number has more value?
quests.explanation: 136 is smaller than 180 -- when counting up, 136 comes earlier!
quests.funFact: Double 136 is 272! Because 136 + 136 = 272.

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 130, 157, or 134?
quests.hint: The greatest number is the one you'd reach last while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 130, 157, and 134, the number 157 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 157, you get 158!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.hint: Break the word into parts -- does it sound like a small number, a "teen", or a bigger one?
quests.explanation: "One Hundred Sixty" is how we say the number 160 in English, so 160 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: If you had 160 apples and found one more, you would have 161 apples!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 16, 26, 36, __?
quests.hint: The pattern counts up by 10 each time. What comes after 36?
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 10, so after 36 comes 36 + 10 = 46!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 46, you get 47!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 26 in a line?
quests.hint: Count places in order: 1st, 2nd, 3rd... keep going until you reach position 26.
quests.explanation: Position 26 in a line is called the "Twenty-Sixth" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: You use the word 'Twenty-Sixth' to show someone's place in a line or a race!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 177 or 187?
quests.hint: Picture counting all the way up -- whichever number you'd reach later is the answer.
quests.explanation: 187 is greater than 177 -- when counting up, 187 comes later!
quests.funFact: If you add 0 to 187, it stays exactly the same: 187!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the tens place of 191?
quests.hint: Count from the right: ones first, then tens, then hundreds -- find the tens spot.
quests.explanation: In 191, the digit 9 sits in the tens place!
quests.funFact: If you multiply 9 by 10, it becomes 90!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Read the numeral 143 out loud -- what word do you say?
quests.explanation: The numeral 143 is written in words as "One Hundred Forty-Three" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: Did you know? The math word 'One Hundred Forty-Three' is spelled with exactly 20 letters!

quests.instruction: Which number is smaller: 114 or 123?
quests.hint: Compare the digits from left to right: which number has more value?
quests.explanation: 114 is smaller than 123 -- when counting up, 114 comes earlier!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 114 comes right after 113!

quests.instruction: Is 104 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Count by twos (2, 4, 6, 8...) -- does 104 ever land exactly on one of those steps?
quests.explanation: 104 can be split into two equal groups with nothing left over, so 104 is Even!
quests.funFact: Even numbers always end in 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the ones place of 98?
quests.hint: Cover up every digit except the ones digit in 98.
quests.explanation: In 98, the digit 8 sits in the ones place!
quests.funFact: The number 8 is an even number!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the ones place of 120?
quests.hint: Split 120 into its place-value parts, then find the ones part.
quests.explanation: In 120, the digit 0 sits in the ones place!
quests.funFact: Zero is a special even number that comes before 1.

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 96 or 90?
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further right is bigger.
quests.explanation: 96 is greater than 90 -- when counting up, 96 comes later!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 96 comes right after 95!

quests.instruction: Which number is the smallest: 144, 171, or 175?
quests.hint: Compare them two at a time, then keep the smaller one.
quests.explanation: Out of 144, 171, and 175, the number 144 is the smallest!
quests.funFact: If you had 144 apples and found one more, you would have 145 apples!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 27 in a line?
quests.hint: This word tells you WHERE something is in line, not how many there are in total.
quests.explanation: Position 27 in a line is called the "Twenty-Seventh" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: You use the word 'Twenty-Seventh' to show someone's place in a line or a race!

quests.instruction: Which number is smaller: 172 or 148?
quests.hint: Picture counting all the way up -- whichever number you'd reach first is the answer.
quests.explanation: 148 is smaller than 172 -- when counting up, 148 comes earlier!
quests.funFact: If you multiply 148 by 10, it becomes 1480!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 28, 30, 32, __?
quests.hint: The pattern counts up by 2 each time. What comes after 32?
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 2, so after 32 comes 32 + 2 = 34!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 34, you get 35!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 2, 4, 6, 8, __?
quests.hint: Add the same jump size again to the last number in the pattern.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 2, so after 8 comes 8 + 2 = 10!
quests.funFact: If you had 10 apples and found one more, you would have 11 apples!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 152, 199, or 135?
quests.hint: The greatest number is the one you'd reach last while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 152, 199, and 135, the number 199 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 199 comes right after 198!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.hint: Sound the word out slowly, then count that many fingers to check.
quests.explanation: "One Hundred Sixty-Three" is how we say the number 163 in English, so 163 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 163 comes just before 164!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the tens place of 168?
quests.hint: Split 168 into its place-value parts, then find the tens part.
quests.explanation: In 168, the digit 6 sits in the tens place!
quests.funFact: The number 6 is an even number!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 18, 23, 28, __?
quests.hint: The pattern counts up by 5 each time. What comes after 28?
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 5, so after 28 comes 28 + 5 = 33!
quests.funFact: The number 33 has two digits: a 3 in the tens place and a 3 in the ones place!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 128, 89, or 130?
quests.hint: Line all three numbers up in counting order first.
quests.explanation: Out of 128, 89, and 130, the number 130 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you had 130 apples and found one more, you would have 131 apples!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Read the numeral 188 out loud -- what word do you say?
quests.explanation: The numeral 188 is written in words as "One Hundred Eighty-Eight" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: The word 'One Hundred Eighty-Eight' helps us communicate numbers without just drawing shapes!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 88 or 91?
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further right is bigger.
quests.explanation: 91 is greater than 88 -- when counting up, 91 comes later!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 91 comes just before 92!

quests.instruction: Which number is the smallest: 153, 130, or 116?
quests.hint: Compare them two at a time, then keep the smaller one.
quests.explanation: Out of 153, 130, and 116, the number 116 is the smallest!
quests.funFact: If you add 0 to 116, it stays exactly the same: 116!

quests.instruction: Which number is the smallest: 151, 100, or 111?
quests.hint: The smallest number is the one you'd reach first while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 151, 100, and 111, the number 100 is the smallest!
quests.funFact: The number 100 is an even number!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the tens place of 185?
quests.hint: Cover up every digit except the tens digit in 185.
quests.explanation: In 185, the digit 8 sits in the tens place!
quests.funFact: If you had 8 apples and found one more, you would have 9 apples!

quests.instruction: Is 181 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Try to share 181 things between two friends equally -- does anyone get a leftover?
quests.explanation: 181 cannot be split into two equal groups -- there's always one left over, so 181 is Odd!
quests.funFact: Odd numbers always end in 1, 3, 5, 7, or 9!
